logic_errors.trigger: On a nonempty MS, select an empty/reversed interval or an interval starting beyond the final timestep.
logic_errors.justification: GetRowRange now returns [nrow,nrow), but its production callers still dereference the beginning. MSRowProvider::Initialize reads TIME(BeginRow()) at msproviders/rowproviders/msrowprovider.cpp:75, so normal reordering throws an out-of-range exception. The contiguous path likewise dereferences _startRow in contiguousms.cpp:160 when msprovidercollection.cpp:79 calls StartTime(). The new loader guard handles only ReadMsInMemory; the shared-range tests check indices without exercising these callers.
logic_errors.recommendation: Handle empty ranges in the row-provider initialization and start-time consumers, and add regressions through the actual reordering and contiguous-provider workflows.

suggestions.suggestion: Add skipped MODEL reads followed by a later MODEL read. Run currently requests MODEL on every row, leaving that part of the independent-stream acceptance without direct skip coverage.

summary: Independently inspected the requested diffs, full regression files, acceptance criteria and relevant callers. Found one blocking empty-range caller defect. No files changed or tests run; threaded gridder header excluded.
